import Std.Tactic

namespace DiscoveryGilbreathConjecture

def seq : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => seq n + (0)

/-- Obligation 1 of 3: the base case, isolated from all algebra. -/
theorem seqBaseCase : seq 0 = 1 := by
  rfl

/-- Obligation 2 of 3: a pure polynomial identity. No induction appears here. -/
theorem seqSuccessorIdentity (n : Nat) :
    (1) + (0) = (1) := by
  simp only [
    Nat.pow_succ,
    Nat.pow_zero,
    Nat.one_mul,
    Nat.mul_one,
    Nat.mul_assoc,
    Nat.add_mul,
    Nat.mul_add,
  ]
  omega

/-- Obligation 3 of 3: the induction skeleton. It cites the two lemmas above and
    performs no algebra of its own. -/
theorem seqClosedForm (n : Nat) :
    seq n = (1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [seq, ih]
      exact seqSuccessorIdentity n

end DiscoveryGilbreathConjecture
